topics.purpose: Define exact record/object shape as a composition of field identities, constraints and extension policy.

semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable record shape/schema surface has explicit identity/version.
semantics.ordering_rule: Field serialization order is non-semantic unless exact shape declares otherwise.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Additive/breaking shape evolution follows exact version/identity rules.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
